extracted.intended_audience: Bearer of NFL game/event credentials, Accredited Organizations, Media Bearers, and Accredited Media Organizations covering NFL games and events
extracted.subtask_description: Terms and enforceable rules governing use of NFL game and event credentials by individuals (Bearers), Accredited Organizations, and media organizations, including access, permitted uses of content, restrictions, waivers, and dispute resolution. Includes general credential rules and separate Media Credential Use Conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on copying or distributing credential depiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not copy, post or otherwise distribute any photograph, image, video or other depiction or description of this credential on any social networking/media site, any other website or in any other media whatsoever now or hereafter existing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Absolute prohibition; applies to credential itself irrespective of other permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No photography/recording in credentialed areas except authorized
rubrics_metrics.description: Taking or recording photographs and videos is strictly PROHIBITED in areas of any Facility for which the credential is required for access, except as authorized by the Media Credential Use Conditions in Part II below or as otherwise expressly authorized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only exceptions are those expressly authorized (e.g., Media Credential Use Conditions or other express authorization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-transferability and lost/stolen reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: NFL GAME AND EVENT CREDENTIALS are non-transferable. Immediately report any lost or stolen credentials to NFL or NFL member club security. Lost or stolen credentials may be replaced at the discretion of the issuing NFL entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credential card may not be transferred or assigned by Bearer or Accredited Organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited purpose and authorized user requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The credential provides privileged and revocable access to an Accredited Organization for the sole purpose of authorizing access to a designated Member Club stadium/facility for an individual (the Bearer) who is working for, or on behalf of, the Accredited Organization, or who otherwise has a legitimate working or other function at the Game or Event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bearer may use credential only directly for or on behalf of the Accredited Organization to perform assigned duties; unauthorized personal use not permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revocation at sole discretion
rubrics_metrics.description: A League Entity or the host Member Club, at its or their sole discretion, may revoke any Accredited Organization’s or individual Bearer’s credentials at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NFL Entities (League Entities and Member Clubs) have broad unilateral revocation rights and are third-party beneficiaries with enforcement rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to be bound by credential terms and facility policies
rubrics_metrics.description: By accepting this credential, the Bearer and the Accredited Organization acknowledge having read and agree to be bound by these Credential Use Conditions and all other policies, regulations and rules issued for the Event and the Facilities, including security and health and safety policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Bearers and Accredited Media Organizations are also subject to the Media Credential Use Conditions in Part II.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences for unauthorized use
rubrics_metrics.description: Any unauthorized use of the credential card subjects the Bearer to ejection and possible prosecution and subjects the Accredited Organization to revocation of credentials for future Games and Events and/or termination of any agreement between such Accredited Organization and any League Entity or Member Club.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unauthorized use triggers ejection, possible criminal prosecution, and organizational penalties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consent to searches and waiver
rubrics_metrics.description: Bearer, along with Bearer’s belongings, may be searched or assessed prior to or upon entry into the Facilities. By accepting this credential, Bearer consents to such searches and waives any claim against the NFL, its Member Clubs, affiliates, agents, contractors, and facility owners/operators in connection therewith.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Bearer declines to consent to searches, Bearer will be denied access to the Facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Behavioral compliance and safety-based revocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Bearer agrees to comply with all Game and Event policies. If Bearer is deemed disorderly, or fails to comply with Credential Use Conditions, security measures, health assessments or policies, or if an NFL Entity determines Bearer poses a risk to health/safety, credential will be revoked and Bearer will be ejected and may face prosecution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accredited Organization may also face revocation of future credentials or termination of agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: No entitlement to damages for denied/refused access or cancellations
rubrics_metrics.description: If admission is refused or withdrawn, Bearer is ejected, a credential card is revoked, or the Game or Event is canceled, THE BEARER AND/OR ACCREDITED ORGANIZATION WILL NOT BE ENTITLED TO CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, EXEMPLARY, OR SPECIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This clause covers denied entry, revocation, cancellations, or access modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assumption of risk and waiver of claims
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accredited Organization and the Bearer understand that Bearer’s presence involves risks (including personal injury or death). They knowingly and voluntarily assume all risks, agree to waive any and all claims (other than workers’ compensation claims), and agree to indemnify and hold harmless the NFL Entities except for liability arising from willful or intentional misconduct of the NFL Entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes risks from communicable diseases (e.g., COVID-19), lost/stolen/damaged property, and a waiver of responsibility for equipment in use in the stadium.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unauthorized distribution prohibition and IP license to NFL
rubrics_metrics.description: Bearer and Accredited Organization agree to not copy, post or otherwise distribute any photograph, image, video or other depiction or description of this credential, or (except for Media Bearers per Part II) any part of the Event or related events (the “Works”), on any social networking/media site, any other website or in any other media whatsoever.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bearer grants the NFL an exclusive, worldwide, sub-licensable, royalty-free license to all copyrights associated with the Works by causing the credential to be scanned upon entry or by signing/submitting required application documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image, voice, and likeness release to NFL Entities and affiliates
rubrics_metrics.description: Bearer’s image, voice and/or likeness may be captured; Bearer grants the NFL Entities and their sponsors, licensees, advertisers, broadcasters, designees, partners, vendors and agents the irrevocable right to capture, use, process, publish, distribute and/or modify Bearer’s voice, image or likeness in any media now known or hereafter existing for any purpose whatsoever, including commercial purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use includes display on stadium video boards, with or without magnification or filters; applies worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data collection and privacy policy acknowledgment
rubrics_metrics.description: Bearer and Accredited Organization agree that Bearer data may be collected, used, and/or disclosed in connection with credential use and attendance, including via Facility Wi‑Fi and NFL/NFL Entity websites and apps; Bearer acknowledges having read and understood applicable privacy policies (e.g., NFL Stadium & Event Credentialing Privacy Policy, NFL’s Privacy Policy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broadcasters or third parties independent of NFL Entities may film and are separate data controllers; NFL not responsible for how those parties use personal information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on exposing third-party brands
rubrics_metrics.description: While at the Game and/or Event, the Accredited Organization and the Bearer are prohibited from providing exposure to any third-party brand(s) (e.g., marks, logos) for commercial, marketing or publicity purposes including through exposure on apparel, accessories or equipment worn or used by the Bearer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers any form of third-party brand exposure that would provide commercial benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory arbitration and class action waiver
rubrics_metrics.description: Any dispute related to the credential, Credential Use Conditions, or Bearer’s presence at the Game or Event shall be resolved by mandatory, confidential, final, and binding arbitration in the city where the Facility is located; all such disputes shall be arbitrated on an individual basis and parties waive the right to court/jury trial and to class/representative actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clause governed by the Federal Arbitration Act; if the Accredited Organization or Bearer does not consent, the Bearer must leave or not enter the Facility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing law
rubrics_metrics.description: These Credential Use Conditions shall be governed by the laws of the state where the Facility of the applicable Game or Event is located, without regard to choice of law principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies alongside the arbitration clause for dispute resolution context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severability
rubrics_metrics.description: If any provision is determined to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, it shall be deemed severed and not affect enforcement of the remaining provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remaining terms enforced as if the invalid provision were not included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media acceptance requires additional terms and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Acceptance by any Media Bearer of credentialed access constitutes agreement by the Accredited Media Organization to be bound by the General Credential Use Conditions and the Media Credential Use Conditions, and, to the extent required, an executed Arbitration and Release and Liability Waiver Form and the NFL Official Rule Book governing field access, plus any other rules issued by League Entities or host Member Clubs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Bearers must comply with additional season/year forms and specific field/stadium access rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted media uses (news and editorial only)
rubrics_metrics.description: The credential authorizes the Accredited Media Organization, solely for news and editorial coverage purposes, to use descriptions, accounts, film, video or digital still images from the Game or Event and limited use of NFL Marks in connection with such uses (collectively, “Game and Event Material”).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorized uses include licensing/distribution to third parties only if (i) the Accredited Media Organization is an established news wire or photo-licensing service, (ii) such licensing/distribution is in ordinary course of business, and (iii) the Accredited Media Organization contractually requires third parties to use the materials solely for news/editorial coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibited media uses without advance written permission
rubrics_metrics.description: Any other use or attempted use by Media Bearer or Accredited Media Organization of Game and Event Material or Marks is expressly prohibited unless advance written permission is obtained from the applicable League Entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibited uses include (x) distribution/licensing to third parties other than ultimate consumers for such third party’s use, (y) authorizing third parties to redistribute Game and Event Material (e.g., play-by-play data feeds), and (z) any non-editorial/commercial use (e.g., daily fantasy sports, sports betting products, apparel, posters, commemorative programs, merchandise, or sponsored content).

rubrics_metrics.name: New media distribution platform limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Accredited Media Organization may use new media distribution platforms it controls provided that (i) any use of film/video/digital still images is limited to a reasonable amount and used only to illustrate/support news and editorial coverage (not for commercial products), (ii) such images are not used to create Simulated Video of game action, (iii) no video of game action is used (except limited simulcast exceptions for television broadcasters), and (iv) non-game audio/video obtained via credential is subject to specific time, live/archival, contextual, and linking restrictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For non-game audio/video: (1) 90 seconds maximum per day (180 seconds in two-Member Club markets), (2) may not be posted or streamed live or in real time and may not be archived for more than 24 hours, (3) must appear only in an editorial context (no sponsorship/merchandising/advertising integrated), and (4) must be accompanied by links back to NFL.com and the applicable Member Club’s website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate license required for more detailed/immediate uses
rubrics_metrics.description: Any proposed use of Game and Event Material that is more detailed and/or immediate than described herein or which exceeds the limits set forth, and any exceptions to prohibitions, requires a separate license from the applicable League Entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact League Entity for permissions beyond the prescribed editorial/news limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Game video governed by NFL Video Highlights License
rubrics_metrics.description: Game video content (including all game action and ancillary on-field activities occurring inside the Facility on gameday) may be used only by Accredited Media Organizations in accordance with the NFL Video Highlights License.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference provided to the 2024 Video Highlights License for detailed terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio Highlights limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Audio Highlights are subject to limitations: (a) only used by Accredited Media Organizations as part of regularly scheduled news programs or sports wrap-ups that do not focus disproportionately on the NFL; (b) no Audio Highlights from games in progress; (c) on game days, up to two minutes of Audio Highlights from any one game and up to six minutes total from all games that day; (d) on non-game days, up to one minute from any one game in the prior six days and up to two minutes total from all games in the prior six days; (e) Audio Highlights may not be used in connection with or associated with any third party (e.g., a sponsor).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict time caps and contextual limits; intended to prevent commercial/sponsored use of audio snippets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty to prevent unauthorized/infringing third-party uses
rubrics_metrics.description: The Accredited Media Organization shall use reasonable efforts to (i) prevent the unauthorized and/or infringing use of Game and Event Material by third parties and (ii) promptly take action against any such unauthorized and/or infringing use brought to its attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligation to police downstream uses when licensing/distributing materials as permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: No video/Simulated Video of Game content and no streaming during game/event
rubrics_metrics.description: The credential does not authorize the Media Bearer to create or use or transmit video, or to animate, sequence, loop or otherwise manipulate film or digital still images to appear to be video (“Simulated Video”) of Game content. Streaming of any Game and Event Materials while the Game is being played or the Event is occurring—in any form, medium, or duration—is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even issued to video personnel, credential only authorizes video of non-Game activities; sideline/close proximity video of Game content requires a separate Sideline/Close Proximity Video Access Agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: No play-by-play or real-time statistical accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: While a Game or Event is in progress, the Accredited Media Organization’s and Media Bearer’s distribution of Game and Event Material must be time-delayed and/or limited in amount and may not, under any circumstances, involve, constitute, serve as a substitute for, or otherwise approximate, a play-by-play or statistical account or depiction of a Game or Event in any medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: score updates limited to quarterly game updates; fewer than 10 photographs during the game; distribution must not approximate play-by-play or be a substitute for live coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on unauthorized transmission of accounts or play-by-play data for commercial enterprises
rubrics_metrics.description: Unauthorized transmission of any accounts or descriptions of the Event, including play-by-play data, and any distribution thereof by, to, or for any commercial enterprise, and/or any public performance or display thereof, direct or indirect, are strictly prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets commercial redistribution or use of detailed game accounts, including for data feeds or commercial partners (e.g., betting operators).
